title: PriceProtectionTerm - Data API
description: Represents a configuration record that defines the rules, types, and eligible conditions for price protection. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

CalculationReferenceRecordId.description: Rebate type that's applicable for the claim amount calculation. This field is a relationship field.

IsPayable.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsPayable.description: Indicates whether the inventory is eligible for payment or refund after a price protection adjustment. The default value is false.

LastViewedDate.description: Date and the timestamp when the record was last viewed by the user. Helps in understanding record engagement.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: Unique name for the Price Protection Term. This is typically used as a primary identifier for UI display or business logic.

NewSalePriceType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
NewSalePriceType.description: Defines the type of new sale price applicable after a price protection scenario. This helps classify how the adjusted sale price can be handled.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: Identifier for the user or group who owns the record. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

PriceProtectionType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
PriceProtectionType.description: Defines the type of price protection applied. Possible values are: PriceProtection—Price Protection ReversePriceProtection—Reverse Price Protection The default value is PriceProtection.

SalePriceType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SalePriceType.description: Specifies the type of sale price before price protection is applied. This helps calculate the protection delta during claim processing.

SupportedPricePercent.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort, Update
SupportedPricePercent.description: Indicates the percentage of the price that is supported for price protection. Helps calculate eligible claim amounts.

SupportedQuantityPercent.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort, Update
SupportedQuantityPercent.description: Indicates the percentage of quantity that is eligible for price protection. Used to determine prorated reimbursement.
